query:
SELECT s.id, s.name,
               ARRAY(
                   SELECT d.host FROM domains d WHERE d.service_id = s.id
                   GROUP BY d.host
                   ORDER BY bool_and(d.is_preview), min(d.created_at), d.host
               ) AS "hosts!"
        FROM services s
        JOIN access_policies p ON p.service_id = s.id AND p.enabled
        ORDER BY s.name
